article: git reset後のコミット復元
scope: Compared the complete Japanese instructions with all twelve translations and official git-reset/reflog manuals, including command order, ref selection, destructive effects, dates, and links.
findings: Removed duplicate future dates, retained original date 2024-05-15, and set lastmod to review date.
Corrected the article’s incomplete and unsafe recovery advice: inspect the reflog, inspect the candidate commit, save it under a rescue branch, then reset only if desired.
Explained that HEAD@{1} is only an example and the user must select the matching reflog entry and a new branch name.
Warned that git reset --hard discards uncommitted tracked-file changes, reflog cannot restore already-discarded edits, and shared history generally calls for git revert after coordination.
Rewrote all twelve translations to match the safer workflow and added Git’s official manuals.

terminology.note: Checked HEAD, reflog entry, commit, branch, tracked/uncommitted changes, hard reset, and revert terminology in all translations.
